items.item: Every field has a visible label above it; no placeholder is used as the label
items.evidence: label.lbl (display:block, margin-bottom) above Customer, Invoice number, Invoice date, Payment terms, Due date, PO reference, Notes. Placeholders are only example values (PO-2026-0418, bank-transfer text). Line-item cells are labelled by column headers (th) plus aria-label; Description placeholder just repeats its header.

items.item: Field widths match the expected input (dates and quantities are narrow)
items.evidence: Invoice number w-44, dates w-40, terms w-40, PO w-56, customer max-w-xl; Qty column th.w-20, price w-32, tax w-24 versus a wide description column. Screenshot confirms narrow date and qty fields.

items.item: Required fields are marked with an asterisk
items.evidence: * on Customer, Invoice number, Invoice date, Due date, and on Item/Qty/Unit price headers; legend '* Required' under the h1. aria-required set on inputs.

items.item: Line items can be added and removed; quantities, prices and amounts are right-aligned with tabular figures
items.evidence: #add-line -> addLine(); per-row [data-remove] button splices state.lines, with an Undo toast. .num {text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} applied to qty/price/tax inputs, amount td and the th headers. Audit numericCells misaligned 0, nonTabular 0.

items.item: Subtotal, tax and total are computed and right-aligned with locale currency formatting
items.evidence: renderTotals(): Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN',{style:'currency',currency:'VND'}) fills #t-sub, per-rate VAT rows and #t-total; dd.num is right-aligned and tabular, in a justify-between dl. Tax is grouped per rate.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with three or more errors a summary appears and focus moves to the first error
items.evidence: Static fields: el.addEventListener('blur', ... checkField(f)); line cells validated in tbody focusout -> renderLineErrors(); customer on blur and choose(). Submit handler: collectErrors(); renderSummary(errs) renders '<n> fields need attention' only when errs.length>=3, then focusTarget(errs[0].target) focuses the first error. Summary links focus each field.

items.item: Save is not disabled before submitting; it is disabled only while the submission is in progress
items.evidence: #save is a plain type=submit button with no disabled attribute in the markup; btn.disabled=true is set only inside save() with a spinner, and cleared in the 800ms timeout; submit also guards on state.saving.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable in a sticky bar, and leaving with unsaved changes asks for confirmation
items.evidence: Div 'sticky bottom-0 ... border-t' holds #cancel and #save (Cancel then Save); visible at the bottom of the 1440x900 screenshot while the form continues below. markDirty() sets 'Unsaved changes'; confirmLeave() opens the <dialog id=leave> 'You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?' with Stay/Leave for Cancel, sidebar and breadcrumb links; also a beforeunload handler.

notes: No template tells found: no greeting header, KPI tiles, gradients, glass, uppercase tracked labels, emoji icons, status rainbow, promo card, decorative chart, hover-lift or oversized radius (radii 4px and 6px). Sections are flat bordered panels on a slate-50 canvas, not nested cards; the sidebar is white with a light blue-50 active item, not navy/indigo. The initials 'LH' avatar belongs to a real user (Lê Thu Hà), so it is not a non-person avatar. Audit score 100, no violations. Minor observations: the line-item amount cells show plain numbers with the VND unit in the header, while totals use the full currency format. The sticky bar is -mx-6 so it slightly overhangs the max-w-5xl content column, which is cosmetic. The customer picker is a custom combobox button, so it is not a native input, but it is focusable and receives the first-error focus. The form loads behind a 450ms skeleton.
